story: Week 7 of the NFL opens Thursday, 22 October, at 8:15 p.m. ET at Soldier Field. The New England Patriots visit the Chicago Bears on Prime Video. ESPN's betting line lists Chicago as a 3-point favorite. Both franchises enter the contest at 4-2. Monday night's result is official: the 49ers beat the Commanders 23-17 to improve to 6-0, while Washington fell to 1-4-1. The Chiefs and Vikings remain undefeated at 5-0. Week 7 byes are the Bills, Jaguars, Chargers and Commanders.
stakes: The first result of Week 7. Both clubs are listed at 4-2, and the line favors Chicago by 3.
